cues.en: Welcome back.
cues.zh: 歡迎回來。

cues.en: So we just went through this whole flow of how data is used by a company.
cues.zh: 剛才走過公司如何使用資料的整個流程。

cues.en: But there's a few more things I want to talk about, because right now we just talked about water and how does this really apply?
cues.zh: 不過還有幾件事想談，因為剛才一直在說水，那實際如何應用？

cues.en: What kind of tools do data engineers actually use?
cues.zh: 資料工程師到底使用什麼工具？

cues.en: Well, you may have heard of something like.
cues.zh: 你可能聽過，

cues.en: Kafka and we'll get to Kafka later on.
cues.zh: Kafka，後面會談 Kafka。

cues.en: But something like collecting these data streams and putting them into a data lake.
cues.zh: 像是收集這些資料串流，再放進資料湖，

cues.en: Might be something that Kafka or Apache Kafka might do for data lakes, for example.
cues.zh: 就可能用 Kafka，也就是 Apache Kafka 來處理。至於資料湖，

cues.en: These are simply programs that companies can use.
cues.zh: 這些就是公司可以使用的軟體。

cues.en: For example, you may have heard of Hadoop or Amazon S3 or the Azure Data Lake.
cues.zh: 例如可能聽過 Hadoop、Amazon S3，或 Azure Data Lake。

cues.en: These are programs that have been built by engineers to hold large amounts of data, like a data leak.
cues.zh: 都是工程師建立、可以像資料湖那樣儲存大量資料的系統。

cues.en: And then for our data warehouse, we have tools like Google, BigQuery, Amazon, Redshift, even Amazon, Athena.
cues.zh: 資料倉儲則有 Google BigQuery、Amazon Redshift，甚至 Amazon Athena 這類工具。

cues.en: These are data warehouses that allow engineers to make queries or analyze this structured data.
cues.zh: 講者把它們概稱為資料倉儲，讓工程師查詢或分析結構化資料。

cues.en: Now I know what you're thinking.
cues.zh: 我知道你在想什麼。

cues.en: Who does what in this whole system?
cues.zh: 整個系統裡，誰做什麼？

cues.en: We've learned that the data engineer creates this entire system for us.
cues.zh: 已經知道，資料工程師替我們建立整套系統。

cues.en: They use different tools and programs to ingest data and then put it into a data lake or a data warehouse.
cues.zh: 使用各種工具與軟體擷取資料，放進資料湖或資料倉儲。

cues.en: So as a data scientist and a machine learning expert.
cues.zh: 那麼，身為資料科學家與機器學習專家，

cues.en: Which data do you use?
cues.zh: 會使用哪些資料？

cues.en: Pause the video and think about it.
cues.zh: 暫停影片，想一想。

cues.en: Ready for the answer.
cues.zh: 準備好答案了嗎？

cues.en: Well, most of the time, you'd be working with a data lake.
cues.zh: 通常會使用資料湖。

cues.en: Because remember, if you're doing machine learning, the more data you have, the better, right?
cues.zh: 記得，做機器學習時，資料越多越好，對吧？

cues.en: And with machine learning you can use structured or unstructured data.
cues.zh: 而機器學習可以用結構化或非結構化資料。

cues.en: So you can go into a data lake and actually grab a bunch of data to use for your models, whether they're in CSV forms or any other forms.
cues.zh: 所以能到資料湖拿出許多資料給模型使用，不論是 CSV 或其他格式。

cues.en: And usually data warehouses are used by babies or business intelligent people or business analysts or
cues.zh: 資料倉儲通常由 BI，也就是商業智慧人員、商業分析師，或，

cues.en: data analysts to make visualisation or analyze data.
cues.zh: 資料分析師，拿來做視覺化或資料分析。

cues.en: Because the data warehouse has usually more structured data that has been cleaned out than it was when it was a data leak.
cues.zh: 因為資料倉儲通常比原本的資料湖，更有結構，也已經清理過。

cues.en: It's a lot easier to understand and use the data for information.
cues.zh: 更容易理解並用來取得資訊。

cues.en: Now, as a data scientist, you can use the data from a data warehouse.
cues.zh: 當然，資料科學家也可以使用資料倉儲的資料。

cues.en: And this isn't just a rule, it's usually you use whatever data is usable to you.
cues.zh: 這不是硬性規則，通常就是使用對自己有用的資料。

cues.en: But this is a good way to think about things that a data scientist uses as much data that they can, as much useful data as they can.
cues.zh: 不過可以這樣理解：資料科學家盡可能使用更多有用的資料。

cues.en: While somebody like a business intelligence person or a data analyst has already the data cleaned process
cues.zh: 商業智慧人員或資料分析師，則使用資料工程師已經清理、處理好的，

cues.en: by a data engineer and use something like a data warehouse to analyze data.
cues.zh: 資料，透過資料倉儲等工具進行分析。

cues.en: And Google's big query is exactly that.
cues.zh: Google BigQuery 就是這樣。

cues.en: It allows somebody with not too much engineering experience or programming experience to analyze this data in a data warehouse.
cues.zh: 讓沒有太多工程或程式經驗的人，也能分析資料倉儲裡的資料。

cues.en: Another way to think about it is like this usually a software engineer, a software developer, app
cues.zh: 也可以換個角度想：軟體工程師、軟體開發者、應用程式，

cues.en: developer, mobile developer, they build programs and apps that users and customers use and that releases
cues.zh: 開發者、行動開發者，建立使用者與客戶使用的程式與應用，過程中產生，

cues.en: data.
cues.zh: 資料。

cues.en: Then a data engineer would build this piping and pipeline for us to ingest data and store it in different
cues.zh: 接著資料工程師建立管線，擷取資料，並儲存在不同，

cues.en: services like Hadoop, like Google, BigQuery, so that that data can be accessed by the rest of the business.
cues.zh: 服務，例如 Hadoop、Google BigQuery，供公司其他部門存取。

cues.en: Next, we have data scientists that use the data lake, as well as the data scientists to extract information
cues.zh: 然後資料科學家利用資料湖，以及其他資料資源，擷取資訊，

cues.en: and deliver some sort of business value.
cues.zh: 提供某種商業價值。

cues.en: Finally, we have data analysts or business intelligence to use something like a data warehouse or structured
cues.zh: 最後，資料分析師或商業智慧人員，使用資料倉儲或結構化，

cues.en: data to, again, derive business value.
cues.zh: 資料，同樣產生商業價值。

cues.en: And I hope that clears the picture a little bit when you hear all these titles out there in the industry.
cues.zh: 希望你下次聽到這些業界職稱時，概念會更清楚。

cues.en: Now, the industry is fast evolving and there's definitely some overlap.
cues.zh: 業界變化很快，工作之間肯定有重疊。

cues.en: And sometimes what one job description might say might be different than the other.
cues.zh: 有時某份職缺描述，也會與另一份不同。

cues.en: But these are general, simplified rules that you can use to understand how each role plays into the part of a company.
cues.zh: 不過這些簡化的概括方式，可以幫助理解各角色在公司裡的分工。
